verses.original: δὲ Εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοῦ τοὺς μαθητὰς ἐστιν Ἀνένδεκτόν μὴ τοῦ τὰ σκάνδαλα ἐλθεῖν πλὴν οὐαὶ δι’ οὗ ἔρχεται
verses.transliteration: de Eipen pros autou tous mathētas estin Anendekton mē tou ta skandala elthein plēn ouai di’ hou erchetai
verses.literal: - [Jesus] said to His - disciples It is inevitable . . . that - stumbling blocks will come but woe [ to the one ] through whom they come

verses.original: λυσιτελεῖ αὐτῷ εἰ λίθος μυλικὸς περίκειται περὶ αὐτοῦ τὸν τράχηλον καὶ ἔρριπται εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν ἢ ἵνα ἕνα τούτων τῶν μικρῶν σκανδαλίσῃ
verses.transliteration: lysitelei autō ei lithos mylikos perikeitai peri autou ton trachēlon kai erriptai eis tēn thalassan ē hina hena toutōn tōn mikrōn skandalisē
verses.literal: It would be better for him to have a millstone . . . hung around his - neck and to be thrown into the sea than {to cause} one of these - little [ones] to stumble

verses.original: Προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς ἐὰν σου ὁ ἀδελφός ἁμάρτῃ ἐπιτίμησον αὐτῷ καὶ ἐὰν μετανοήσῃ ἄφες αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Prosechete heautois ean sou ho adelphos hamartē epitimēson autō kai ean metanoēsē aphes autō
verses.literal: Watch yourselves If your - brother sins rebuke him and if he repents forgive him

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν ἁμαρτήσῃ εἰς σὲ ἑπτάκις τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ ἑπτάκις ἐπιστρέψῃ πρὸς σὲ λέγων Μετανοῶ ἀφήσεις αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai ean hamartēsē eis se heptakis tēs hēmeras kai heptakis epistrepsē pros se legōn Metanoō aphēseis autō
verses.literal: Even if he sins against you seven times in a day and seven times returns . . . . . . to say I repent you must forgive him

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ ἀπόστολοι εἶπαν τῷ Κυρίῳ Πρόσθες ἡμῖν πίστιν
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi apostoloi eipan tō Kyriō Prosthes hēmin pistin
verses.literal: - The apostles said to the Lord Increase our faith

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Κύριος Εἶπεν Εἰ ἔχετε πίστιν ὡς κόκκον σινάπεως ἂν ἐλέγετε ταύτῃ τῇ συκαμίνῳ Ἐκριζώθητι καὶ φυτεύθητι ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ καὶ ἂν ὑπήκουσεν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: de ho Kyrios Eipen Ei echete pistin hōs kokkon sinapeōs an elegete tautē tē sykaminō Ekrizōthēti kai phyteuthēti en tē thalassē kai an hypēkousen hymin
verses.literal: And the Lord answered If you have faith the size vvv of a mustard seed vvv you can say to this - mulberry tree Be uprooted and planted in the sea and vvv it will obey you

verses.original: δὲ Τίς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἔχων δοῦλον ὃς εἰσελθόντι ἐκ ἀροτριῶντα ἢ ποιμαίνοντα τοῦ ἀγροῦ ἐρεῖ αὐτῷ παρελθὼν Εὐθέως ἀνάπεσε
verses.transliteration: de Tis ex hymōn echōn doulon hos eiselthonti ek arotriōnta ē poimainonta tou agrou erei autō parelthōn Eutheōs anapese
verses.literal: - Which of you [whose] servant - comes in from plowing or shepherding in the field will say to him Come at once [and] sit down to eat

verses.original: ἀλλ’ οὐχὶ ἐρεῖ αὐτῷ Ἑτοίμασον τί δειπνήσω καὶ περιζωσάμενος διακόνει μοι ἕως φάγω καὶ πίω καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα σύ φάγεσαι καὶ πίεσαι
verses.transliteration: all’ ouchi erei autō Hetoimason ti deipnēsō kai perizōsamenos diakonei moi heōs phagō kai piō kai meta tauta sy phagesai kai piesai
verses.literal: Instead vvv won’t he tell him Prepare vvv my meal and dress yourself to serve me while I eat and drink and afterward . . . you may eat and drink

verses.original: ἔχει μὴ χάριν τῷ δούλῳ ὅτι ἐποίησεν τὰ διαταχθέντα
verses.transliteration: echei mē charin tō doulō hoti epoiēsen ta diatachthenta
verses.literal: Does he . . . thank the servant because he did what he was told

verses.original: οὕτως ὑμεῖς καὶ ὅταν ποιήσητε πάντα τὰ διαταχθέντα ὑμῖν λέγετε ὅτι ἐσμεν ἀχρεῖοί Δοῦλοι πεποιήκαμεν ὃ ὠφείλομεν ποιῆσαι
verses.transliteration: houtōs hymeis kai hotan poiēsēte panta ta diatachthenta hymin legete hoti esmen achreioi Douloi pepoiēkamen ho ōpheilomen poiēsai
verses.literal: So you also when you have done everything . . . commanded of you should say - We are unworthy servants we have only done vvv our duty . . .

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ πορεύεσθαι εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ αὐτὸς διήρχετο διὰ μέσον Σαμαρείας καὶ Γαλιλαίας
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto en tō poreuesthai eis Ierousalēm kai autos diērcheto dia meson Samareias kai Galilaias
verses.literal: While . . . vvv vvv [Jesus] was on His way to Jerusalem - He was passing vvv between Samaria and Galilee

verses.original: καὶ αὐτοῦ εἰσερχομένου εἴς τινα κώμην αὐτῷ ἀπήντησαν δέκα λεπροὶ ἄνδρες οἳ ἔστησαν πόρρωθεν
verses.transliteration: kai autou eiserchomenou eis tina kōmēn autō apēntēsan deka leproi andres hoi estēsan porrōthen
verses.literal: As He entered . . . one of [the] villages He was met by ten lepers . . . [They] stood at a distance

verses.original: καὶ αὐτοὶ ἦραν φωνὴν λέγοντες Ἰησοῦ Ἐπιστάτα ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: kai autoi ēran phōnēn legontes Iēsou Epistata eleēson hēmas
verses.literal: and - raised [their] voices shouting Jesus Master have mercy on us

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδὼν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πορευθέντες ἐπιδείξατε ἑαυτοὺς τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν αὐτοὺς τῷ ὑπάγειν ἐκαθαρίσθησαν
verses.transliteration: Kai idōn eipen autois Poreuthentes epideixate heautous tois hiereusin kai egeneto en autous tō hypagein ekatharisthēsan
verses.literal: vvv When [Jesus] saw [them] He said . . . Go show yourselves to the priests And as . . . they - were on their way they were cleansed

verses.original: δὲ Εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἰδὼν ὅτι ἰάθη ὑπέστρεψεν δοξάζων τὸν Θεόν μετὰ μεγάλης φωνῆς
verses.transliteration: de Heis ex autōn idōn hoti iathē hypestrepsen doxazōn ton Theon meta megalēs phōnēs
verses.literal: When one of them saw that he was healed he came back praising - God in a loud voice

verses.original: καὶ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον παρὰ αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας εὐχαριστῶν αὐτῷ καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν Σαμαρίτης
verses.transliteration: kai epesen epi prosōpon para autou tous podas eucharistōn autō kai autos ēn Samaritēs
verses.literal: - He fell vvv facedown at [Jesus’] - feet in thanksgiving to Him and he was a Samaritan

verses.original: Οὐχὶ οἱ δέκα ἐκαθαρίσθησαν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν ποῦ δὲ οἱ ἐννέα
verses.transliteration: Ouchi hoi deka ekatharisthēsan de ho Iēsous Apokritheis eipen pou de hoi ennea
verses.literal: {Were} not [all] ten cleansed - - Jesus asked - Where then are . . . the [other] nine

verses.original: εὑρέθησαν οὐχ εἰ μὴ οὗτος ὁ ἀλλογενὴς ὑποστρέψαντες δοῦναι δόξαν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: heurethēsan ouch ei mē houtos ho allogenēs hypostrepsantes dounai doxan tō Theō
verses.literal: Was no one found . . . except . . . this - foreigner to return [and] give glory - to God

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἀναστὰς πορεύου σου ἡ πίστις σέσωκέν σε
verses.transliteration: kai eipen autō Anastas poreuou sou hē pistis sesōken se
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] said to him Rise [and] go your - faith has made you well . . .

verses.original: δὲ Ἐπερωτηθεὶς ὑπὸ τῶν Φαρισαίων πότε ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἔρχεται ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς καὶ εἶπεν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ Οὐκ ἔρχεται μετὰ παρατηρήσεως
verses.transliteration: de Eperōtētheis hypo tōn Pharisaiōn pote hē basileia tou Theou erchetai apekrithē autois kai eipen hē basileia tou Theou Ouk erchetai meta paratērēseōs
verses.literal: - When asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom - of God would come [Jesus] replied . . . . . . . . . The kingdom - of God {will} not come with observable signs

verses.original: οὐδὲ ἐροῦσιν Ἰδοὺ ὧδε ἤ Ἐκεῖ γὰρ ἰδοὺ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστιν ὑμῶν ἐντὸς
verses.transliteration: oude erousin Idou hōde ē Ekei gar idou hē basileia tou Theou estin hymōn entos
verses.literal: Nor will [people] say Look here [it is] or There [it is] For you see the kingdom - of God is in your midst

verses.original: δὲ Εἶπεν πρὸς τοὺς μαθητάς ἡμέραι Ἐλεύσονται ὅτε ἐπιθυμήσετε ἰδεῖν μίαν τῶν ἡμερῶν τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ οὐκ ὄψεσθε
verses.transliteration: de Eipen pros tous mathētas hēmerai Eleusontai hote epithymēsete idein mian tōn hēmerōn tou Huiou tou anthrōpou kai ouk opsesthe
verses.literal: Then He said to the disciples [The] time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son - of Man but vvv you will not see [it]

verses.original: καὶ ἐροῦσιν ὑμῖν Ἰδοὺ ἐκεῖ ἤ Ἰδοὺ ὧδε μὴ ἀπέλθητε μηδὲ διώξητε
verses.transliteration: kai erousin hymin Idou ekei ē Idou hōde mē apelthēte mēde diōxēte
verses.literal: - [People] will tell you Look there [He is] or Look here [He is] {Do} not go out [or] chase after [them]

verses.original: γὰρ ὥσπερ ἡ ἀστραπὴ ἀστράπτουσα λάμπει ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανὸν ἐκ τῆς εἰς τὴν ὑπ’ οὐρανὸν οὕτως ἔσται ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐν αὐτοῦ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ
verses.transliteration: gar hōsper hē astrapē astraptousa lampei hypo ton ouranon ek tēs eis tēn hyp’ ouranon houtōs estai ho Huios tou anthrōpou en autou tē hēmera
verses.literal: For just as the lightning flashes [and] lights up - the sky from [one end] to the [other] - - so will be the Son - of Man in His - day

verses.original: δὲ πρῶτον αὐτὸν δεῖ παθεῖν πολλὰ καὶ ἀποδοκιμασθῆναι ἀπὸ ταύτης τῆς γενεᾶς
verses.transliteration: de prōton auton dei pathein polla kai apodokimasthēnai apo tautēs tēs geneas
verses.literal: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this - generation

verses.original: Καὶ καθὼς ἐγένετο ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Νῶε οὕτως καὶ ἔσται ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: Kai kathōs egeneto en tais hēmerais Nōe houtōs kai estai en tais hēmerais tou Huiou tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: Just as it was in the days of Noah so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man

verses.original: ἤσθιον ἔπινον ἐγάμουν ἐγαμίζοντο ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας Νῶε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν καὶ ὁ κατακλυσμὸς ἦλθεν καὶ ἀπώλεσεν πάντας
verses.transliteration: ēsthion epinon egamoun egamizonto achri hēs hēmeras Nōe eisēlthen eis tēn kibōton kai ho kataklysmos ēlthen kai apōlesen pantas
verses.literal: [People] were eating [and] drinking marrying [and] being given in marriage up to [the] day Noah entered . . . the ark Then the flood came and destroyed them all

verses.original: ἐγένετο Ὁμοίως καθὼς ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Λώτ ἤσθιον ἔπινον ἠγόραζον ἐπώλουν ἐφύτευον ᾠκοδόμουν
verses.transliteration: egeneto Homoiōs kathōs en tais hēmerais Lōt ēsthion epinon ēgorazon epōloun ephyteuon ōkodomoun
verses.literal: It was the same . . . in the days of Lot [People] were eating [and] drinking buying [and] selling planting [and] building

verses.original: δὲ ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ Λὼτ ἐξῆλθεν ἀπὸ Σοδόμων πῦρ καὶ θεῖον ἔβρεξεν ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἀπώλεσεν πάντας
verses.transliteration: de hē hēmera Lōt exēlthen apo Sodomōn pyr kai theion ebrexen ap’ ouranou kai apōlesen pantas
verses.literal: But on the day Lot left . . . Sodom fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all

verses.original: ἔσται Κατὰ τὰ αὐτὰ ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἀποκαλύπτεται
verses.transliteration: estai Kata ta auta hē hēmera ho Huios tou anthrōpou apokalyptetai
verses.literal: It will be just like that . . . . . . on the day the Son - of Man is revealed

verses.original: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ μὴ ὃς ἔσται ἐπὶ τοῦ δώματος καὶ καταβάτω ἆραι αὐτά αὐτοῦ τὰ σκεύη ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ καὶ ὁμοίως μὴ ὁ ἐν ἀγρῷ ἐπιστρεψάτω εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω
verses.transliteration: en ekeinē tē hēmera mē hos estai epi tou dōmatos kai katabatō arai auta autou ta skeuē en tē oikia kai homoiōs mē ho en agrō epistrepsatō eis ta opisō
verses.literal: On that - day {let} no one . . . - on the housetop come down to retrieve . . . his - possessions . . . . . . . . . - Likewise {let} no one . . . in [the] field return for anything [he has] left behind

verses.original: μνημονεύετε Λώτ τῆς γυναικὸς
verses.transliteration: mnēmoneuete Lōt tēs gynaikos
verses.literal: Remember Lot’s - wife

verses.original: ὃς ἐὰν ζητήσῃ περιποιήσασθαι αὐτοῦ τὴν ψυχὴν ἀπολέσει αὐτήν δ’ ὃς ἂν ἀπολέσῃ ζωογονήσει αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: hos ean zētēsē peripoiēsasthai autou tēn psychēn apolesei autēn d’ hos an apolesē zōogonēsei autēn
verses.literal: Whoever . . . tries to save his - life will lose it but whoever . . . loses [his life] will preserve it

verses.original: λέγω ὑμῖν ταύτῃ τῇ νυκτὶ δύο ἔσονται ἐπὶ μιᾶς κλίνης ὁ εἷς παραλημφθήσεται καὶ ὁ ἕτερος ἀφεθήσεται
verses.transliteration: legō hymin tautē tē nykti dyo esontai epi mias klinēs ho heis paralēmphthēsetai kai ho heteros aphethēsetai
verses.literal: I tell you on that - night two [people] will be in one bed - one will be taken and the other left

verses.original: δύο ἔσονται ἀλήθουσαι ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό ἡ μία παραλημφθήσεται δὲ ἡ ἑτέρα ἀφεθήσεται
verses.transliteration: dyo esontai alēthousai epi to auto hē mia paralēmphthēsetai de hē hetera aphethēsetai
verses.literal: Two [women] will be grinding grain vvv vvv together - one will be taken and the other left

verses.original: Ποῦ Κύριε Καὶ ἀποκριθέντες λέγουσιν αὐτῷ δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὅπου τὸ σῶμα ἐκεῖ καὶ οἱ ἀετοὶ ἐπισυναχθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Pou Kyrie Kai apokrithentes legousin autō de Ho eipen autois Hopou to sōma ekei kai hoi aetoi episynachthēsontai
verses.literal: Where Lord - they asked . . . . . . - - [Jesus] answered . . . Wherever [there is] a carcass there - the vultures will gather
